findings.source_passage: a herd of remorseless wild pirates and inhuman atheistical devils were infernally cheering him on with their curses;—when all these conceits had passed through his brain
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'As if too long lurking behind the headlands'
findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'inhuman atheistical devils infernally cheering him on with their curses' is an interpretive keystone for Ahab's psychology — the irony that his enemies unwittingly accelerate his doom is the chapter's thematic punchline; the draft compresses it to 'when these conceits had passed,' erasing the specific charge.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'a herd of remorseless wild pirates and inhuman atheistical devils were infernally cheering him on with their curses' before 'his brow was left gaunt and ribbed'; the full clause earns the simile that follows.

findings.source_passage: Ahab's brow was left gaunt and ribbed, like the black sand beach after some stormy tide has been gnawing it, without being able to drag the firm thing from its place.
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'As if too long lurking behind the headlands'
findings.why_it_matters: The closing clause 'without being able to drag the firm thing from its place' is the rhetorical payload of the simile — it names Ahab's immovability; dropping it reduces a signature image to mere description.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full simile verbatim: 'like the black sand beach after some stormy tide has been gnawing it, without being able to drag the firm thing from its place.'

findings.source_passage: Time out of mind the piratical proas of the Malays, lurking among the low shaded coves and islets of Sumatra, have sallied out upon the vessels sailing through the straits
findings.source_locator: third paragraph of source, before 'With a fair, fresh wind'
findings.why_it_matters: This paragraph establishes the Malay threat that drives the chapter's central dramatic irony; its atmospheric voice ('piratical proas,' 'low shaded coves') is entirely dropped, leaving the pirates' appearance later without proper preparation.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at least one sentence of the piratical-proas paragraph, including the lurking-in-coves image, before the Pequod's approach.

summary: The draft preserves most signatures faithfully, including the key lyrical and philosophical passages, but flattens the climactic Ahab-brow paragraph by omitting 'atheistical devils infernally cheering him on with their curses' and truncating the beach simile, reducing an interpretive keystone to atmospheric shorthand.
